pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal dark brown regions with highly irregular, serrated edge boundaries. Pixel gradients at edges are sharp and well-defined. Spatial area of patches is heterogeneous, with larger patches on the upper neck and smaller ones on the lower flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnected cream-colored pathways forming a topological mesh. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial and quadri-radial intersections. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform, maintaining high pixel-level continuity across the observable surface.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A dense, short mane is visible along the dorsal ridge with a jagged 1D silhouette against the background. The profile exhibits high-frequency serration with low, consistent amplitude.

other_distinctive_markers: Localized yellowish-green chromatic anomaly present on the lower-left section of the flank, manifesting as a translucent overlay across multiple patches and corridors.
